candidates.description: This vector represents academic and medical titles, honorifics, and related degree abbreviations.
This vector represents academic research, scientific studies, and investigative processes across multiple languages.
This vector activates on prefixes, roots, and common fragments of proper nouns, academic subjects, and philosophical terms.
This feature vector represents educational and institutional organizations, academies, and universities across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents general nouns and adverbial phrases related to structure, manner, time, and spatial orientation across multiple languages.
This feature activates on names of prestigious universities, academic institutions, and associated proper nouns.
This feature vector represents auxiliary and modal verbs associated with possibility, obligation, and state in Spanish and English.
This feature vector represents technical, systematic, and organizational concepts, predominantly in Spanish.
These tokens represent verbs and related forms expressing relational states, equivalence, or logical correspondence between concepts.
This feature vector represents morphological roots, suffixes, and inflections associated with Spanish verbs and nouns derived from the "-ificar" (to make/to do) suffix family.
